messages:
Evelyn Park: Follow-up from the PM: repeated mid-day GPU pressure -> autoscale lag + quota failures. We need owners, verification steps, and a short-term headroom plan.

Evelyn Park: Proposed immediate actions:
```
H1) Short-term headroom bump (2 GPUs / pool)           -> owner: Marcus Lee   | RL-3801 | due 2026-03-27
H2) Scheduler queue threshold & preemption review       -> owner: Sofia Torres  | RL-3805 | due 2026-03-29
H3) Canary + quick rollback flow                        -> owner: Benji Rao     | RL-3810 | due 2026-03-26
H4) Incident recurrence tagging + weekly trend report   -> owner: Evelyn Park   | RL-3815 | due 2026-03-28
```

Marcus Lee: taking H1. I'll push a conservative headroom change: +2 GPUs per pool and a temporary 15% buffer for 72 hours. Will monitor cpu/gpu_util and error_budget.

Sofia Torres: taking H2. I'll audit current scheduler thresholds and add a low-risk tweak: lower sched_queue_alert by 20% and adjust preemption grace to 60s. Will include rollback patch.

Benji Rao: taking H3. Canary plan: route 1.5% traffic, run 10m burst, and abort if 5xx > 1% or p95 latency > 600ms. Canary command (staging):
```
wrk -t4 -c60 -d10m http://staging/api/v1/generate
```
Rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/autoscaler` or disable headroom flag.

pager-bot: RL links: https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3801 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3805 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3810 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3815

Marcus Lee: quick note: need procurement sign-off if we keep headroom >7 nodes for more than 72h. Tagging infra and procurement.

Sofia Torres: measurement plan: run synthetic burst generator that mimics batching (payloads of 4 requests each) and capture pod_start_ms, sched_queue_length, and evicted_pods metric. Acceptance: no increase in 5xx and 99th pod_start_ms improved.

Benji Rao: I'll add smoke steps to pipeline: basic /health, kv-cache-hit-rate > 45%, and a token-level cost sanity check. Canary scheduled 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC.

Evelyn Park: can we meet for a 15-min checkpoint Fri 15:30 UTC to review metrics? If yes I'll create invite and require 1-line daily updates on RL tickets.

Marcus Lee: works for me.

Sofia Torres: ok.

Benji Rao: fine.

Evelyn Park: also adding a short-term alert: when pool_free_gpus < 2 AND sched_queue_length > 150 for 4m -> page @oncall and create RL with label `gpu-headroom`. Let's keep autoscale conservative while we validate.

pager-bot: Alert prototype created: https://monitoring.internal/alerts/gpu-headroom-proto. Will auto-create RL ticket with label= gpu-headroom.

Evelyn Park: thanks team. We'll reconvene Fri with initial canary and staging results. Please update RL tickets daily. :white_check_mark:
